raw_candidates: One shared whole-selection NPZ; all centroid slots and raw pose arrays, including excluded/empty poses
final_slp_policy: All poses at/above birth threshold, plus lower-score poses successfully linked to established tracks; high-threshold rejected bodies remain unassigned
gap_policy: Up to five intervening missed frames; no synthetic poses; no revival after expiry
motion_policy: Displacement <=12*dt px; prediction residual <=18 px; cost uses displacement/dt and unscaled residual; other body-first gates unchanged
control_policy: Same candidate pool filtered at each birth threshold with unchanged adjacent-frame tracker; tables only, no extra inference or SLPs
